fields.name: published
fields.label: Website is LIVE
fields.description: ON — the full website is public. OFF — visitors see the “Coming soon” page. After you change this and save, it takes about a minute for the website to update.

fields.name: comingSoon
fields.label: “Coming soon” page
fields.description: Shown to visitors while the website is not live.

fields.name: showContact
fields.label: Show the call and WhatsApp buttons

fields.name: title
fields.label: Listing title
fields.description: e.g. “2 BHK Flat”, “Residential Plot”.

fields.name: tag
fields.label: Badge
fields.description: Optional short badge on the photo, e.g. “No brokerage”, “Loan assistance”, “Clear title”.

fields.name: price
fields.label: Price
fields.description: Shown as written, e.g. “₹43 L”, “₹1.2 Cr”, “On request”.

fields.name: bedrooms
fields.label: Bedrooms
fields.description: Leave blank for plots and shops.

fields.name: bathrooms
fields.label: Bathrooms
fields.description: Leave blank for plots and shops.

fields.name: locality
fields.label: Locality
fields.description: e.g. “Vasai West”, “Nalasopara”.

fields.name: facing
fields.label: Facing
fields.description: Optional, e.g. “East”, “North-East”.

fields.name: gallery
fields.label: Photo gallery
fields.description: The card shows these as a carousel. Add at least one; keep files small (mobile data).

fields.name: featured
fields.label: Show on the site
fields.description: Turn on to include this listing in the Featured Properties section.

fields.name: order
fields.label: Sort order
fields.description: Lower numbers show first.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: A short paragraph shown in the pop-up. What was built, and anything the family should know.

fields.name: location
fields.label: Location
fields.description: Area or locality, e.g. “Vasai West”.

fields.name: projectType
fields.label: Type of work
fields.description: e.g. “G+2 bungalow”, “3 BHK full renovation”, “Shop fit-out”.

fields.name: percentComplete
fields.label: Percent complete
fields.description: Optional. A number from 0 to 100 — shown as “60% done”.

fields.name: expectedCompletion
fields.label: Expected completion
fields.description: Optional, e.g. “March 2026”.

fields.name: gallery
fields.label: Photos
fields.description: Add at least one. First photo is used as the card image.

fields.name: alt
fields.label: Describe the photo
fields.description: For screen readers and search engines, e.g. “Front elevation of the completed bungalow”.

fields.name: videoUrl
fields.label: Walkthrough video link
fields.description: Optional. Paste a YouTube or Vimeo link — do not upload video files. Shown in the pop-up.
